payload.content: When Chris starts a new project: ASK for the project name first, do not auto-detect. Create /root/projects/<name>/ from _template scaffold, create MadeAt2AM/<name> private repo via API, first commit+push, then SSH first-pull to dev VPS. project.sh 'new' does this end-to-end. NEVER skip the name confirmation (per memory 2026-07-03).
